title: folder-sync change record, version 1
description: <root>_changes/<project>/<host-id>/<seq, 12 digits>.json: what manifest version <seq> of one host changed. Written once by that host's writer, after the manifest and the hub message; never rewritten; deleted by the pruner 30 days after `at`. One exists for every seq a writer of this format published. See docs/CONTRACT.md, 'Change records'.

seq.description: Equals the manifest's seq and the key's <seq>.

by.description: machine: a round on that machine; web: the folder's web host (a browser write, delete or restore); server: the accounts Worker's over-quota delete job (PEP 0003 §3.7), which builds that manifest itself.

via.description: For by=web: the browser, as /fs/v1/devices names it ("Chrome on Linux").

events.description: In path order. Only upload, delete and restore events, each a full folder-sync-event/1 line with project, host and host_name equal to this record's.
